notes: Ten limit facts. The KSh 500,000 account and daily limits come from the August 2023 press release that announced them (effective 15 Aug 2023); the per-transaction cap now shown is KSh 250,000, up from the KSh 150,000 the same release still quoted, so the two numbers must not be mixed.

entries.subject: mpesa_account_balance_limit
entries.display: Maximum M-PESA account balance KSh 500,000, in force from 15 August 2023
entries.quote: the higher account limit will be effective from tuesday 15 th august 2023 for all m pesa customers
entries.notes: Approved by the Central Bank of Kenya; raised from the previous KSh 300,000.

entries.subject: mpesa_daily_transaction_limit
entries.display: Maximum M-PESA daily transaction value KSh 500,000
entries.quote: m pesa customers are also set to enjoy an increased daily transaction limit of ksh 500 000 per day
entries.notes: A customer may make several transactions up to the daily aggregate.

entries.subject: mpesa_per_transaction_limit
entries.display: Maximum amount per M-PESA transaction KSh 250,000
entries.quote: maximum m pesa account balance kes 500 000 maximum daily transaction limit kes 500 000 maximum amount per transaction kes 250 000 minimum cash withdrawal at an m pesa agent kes 50
entries.notes: Replaces the KSh 150,000 per-transaction cap that the 2023 press release still quoted.

entries.subject: mpesa_minimum_agent_withdrawal
entries.display: Minimum cash withdrawal at an M-PESA agent is KSh 50
entries.quote: minimum cash withdrawal at an m pesa agent kes 50

entries.subject: mpesa_minimum_transaction_amount
entries.display: Minimum M-PESA Express (STK Push) transaction amount KSh 1
entries.quote: the minimum transaction amount is ksh 1
entries.notes: From the Daraja FAQ on M-PESA Express limits; the same answer restates 250,000 per transaction and 500,000 balance and daily limits.

entries.subject: emoney_individual_transaction_limit
entries.display: Statutory ceiling of KSh 75,000 per e-money account transaction, unless CBK approves a higher limit
entries.quote: every e money account issued shall be subject to an individual transaction limit that shall not exceed seventy five thousand shillings and an aggregate monthly load limit of one million shillings
entries.notes: The proviso lets the Bank approve higher limits for specific categories of account, which is how M-PESA operates at 250,000. The regulation's own effective-date clause is blank in the captured text; 2013 is the instrument year.

entries.subject: emoney_aggregate_monthly_load_limit
entries.display: Aggregate monthly load limit KSh 1,000,000 across all e-money accounts a holder has
entries.quote: should an e money issuer issue more than one e money account to an e money holder the total amount loaded into all the e money accounts of that e money holder shall not exceed the aggregate monthly load limit
entries.notes: Load limit is a statutory aggregate across accounts, not per account. effective_from is the instrument year only: the regulation's effective-date clause is blank in the captured text.

entries.subject: airtel_per_transaction_limit
entries.display: Airtel Money maximum amount per transaction KSh 250,000
entries.quote: maximum amount per transaction is kes 250 000

entries.subject: airtel_daily_transaction_limit
entries.display: Airtel Money maximum daily transaction value KSh 500,000
entries.quote: maximum daily transaction value is kes 500 000
entries.notes: Page states the limits were revised with the Central Bank of Kenya during the COVID-19 period; no exact date is given, so effective_from is null.

entries.subject: fuliza_zero_limit_condition
entries.value_text: Customers on the network for less than six months have a zero Fuliza limit
entries.display: Fuliza limit is nil until the line has been active at least 6 months
entries.quote: customers on our network for less than 6 months will have a zero limit
entries.notes: Limit size is set from line activity and repayment record, and can move up or down.
